tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies the Runn API key and connectivity.

tools.name: runn-list-projects
tools.description: List Runn projects. Returns { items: [{ id, name, clientId, isArchived, isConfirmed, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: clientId?, isArchived?, limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn project objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-get-project
tools.description: Get a single Runn project by id. Returns curated detail { id, name, clientId, teamId, isArchived, isConfirmed, pricingModel, rateType, budget, expensesBudget, tags, references, ... }. Params: projectId (required), fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn project object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-create-project
tools.description: Create a Runn project from scratch. Returns the curated created project. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: name, clientId (both required), isConfirmed?, teamId?, budget?, expensesBudget?, pricingModel? (fp|tm|nb), rateType? (hours|days), rateCardId?, fields?, includeRaw.

clientId.description: Client id (required). Use runn-list-clients to find it.

pricingModel.description: fp = fixed price, tm = time & materials, nb = non-billable.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn project object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-update-project
tools.description: Update a Runn project. Only the fields you pass are changed (PATCH semantics). Idempotent — safe to retry. Returns the curated updated project. Params: projectId (required), name?, clientId?, isConfirmed?, teamId?, budget?, expensesBudget?, pricingModel?, rateType?, rateCardId?, fields?, includeRaw.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn project object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-people
tools.description: List Runn people. Returns { items: [{ id, firstName, lastName, email, isArchived, teamId, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Note: a person's role lives in their contract, not on the person. Params: limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn person objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-get-person
tools.description: Get a single Runn person by id. Returns curated detail { id, firstName, lastName, email, isArchived, teamId, tags, references, holidaysGroupId, managers, ... }. Params: personId (required), fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn person object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-create-person
tools.description: Create a Runn person. A first contract (role) is created with them. Returns the curated created person. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: firstName, lastName, roleId (all required), email?, teamId?, startDate? (YYYY-MM-DD), employmentType? (employee|contractor), costPerHour?, fields?, includeRaw.

roleId.description: Role id for the initial contract (required).

startDate.description: Contract start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

costPerHour.description: Cost per hour. Defaults to the role cost.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn person object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-placeholders
tools.description: List Runn placeholders (unnamed role slots used for planning before a real person is assigned). Returns { items: [{ id, firstName, lastName, isArchived, tags, references, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn placeholder objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-create-placeholder
tools.description: Create a Runn placeholder (an unnamed role slot for planning before a real person is hired/assigned). Returns the curated created placeholder. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: roleId (required), teamId?, costPerHour?, fields?, includeRaw.

roleId.description: Role id the placeholder stands in for (required).

costPerHour.description: Cost per hour. Defaults to the role cost.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn placeholder object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-assignments
tools.description: List Runn assignments (a person/placeholder allocated to a project at a role over a date range). Returns { items: [{ id, personId, projectId, roleId, startDate, endDate, minutesPerDay, isBillable, isPlaceholder, ... }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Filter by personId OR projectId (not both). Params: personId?, projectId?, limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn assignment objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-create-assignment
tools.description: Allocate a person (or placeholder) to a project at a role over a date range. Returns the curated created assignment. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: personId, projectId, roleId, startDate, endDate (YYYY-MM-DD), minutesPerDay (all required), isBillable?, note?, phaseId?, workstreamId?, isNonWorkingDay?, fields?, includeRaw.

personId.description: Person OR placeholder id to assign.

roleId.description: Role id the person works as on this assignment.

endDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (on or after startDate).

isBillable.description: Whether the assignment is billable. Default true.

isNonWorkingDay.description: Whether it falls on a non-working day.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn assignment object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-delete-assignment
tools.description: Delete a Runn assignment by id. Irreversible. Returns { success, assignmentId }. Params: assignmentId (required).

tools.name: runn-list-actuals
tools.description: List Runn actuals (logged timesheet hours by day). Returns { items: [{ id, date, personId, projectId, roleId, billableMinutes, nonbillableMinutes, ... }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Filter by personId OR projectId (not both). Params: personId?, projectId?, limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn actual objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-create-actual
tools.description: Log a Runn actual (real hours worked on a day). The minutes overwrite any existing actual for the same day/person/project/role/workstream. Returns the curated actual. Params: date (YYYY-MM-DD), billableMinutes, nonbillableMinutes, personId, projectId, roleId (all required), billableNote?, nonbillableNote?, phaseId?, workstreamId?, fields?, includeRaw.

date.description: Day the work was done, YYYY-MM-DD.

billableNote.description: Optional note for the billable time.

nonbillableNote.description: Optional note for the non-billable time.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn actual object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-clients
tools.description: List Runn clients. Returns { items: [{ id, name, website, isArchived, references, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn client objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-create-client
tools.description: Create a Runn client. Returns the curated created client. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: name (required), website?, fields?, includeRaw.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the result.

includeRaw.description: Return the raw Runn client object. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-roles
tools.description: List Runn roles (job roles people and placeholders are assigned as). Returns { items: [{ id, name, isArchived, defaultHourCost, standardRate, references, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn role objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-teams
tools.description: List Runn teams. Returns { items: [{ id, name, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn team objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-list-skills
tools.description: List Runn skills. Returns { items: [{ id, name, createdAt, updatedAt }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: limit (1-200, def 50), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 200, default 50.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn skill objects. Default false.

tools.name: runn-project-totals
tools.description: Get aggregated minute totals per project (billable, non-billable, total — from actuals when available, falling back to assignments). Returns { items: [{ id, billableMinutes, nonBillableMinutes, totalMinutes, assignments, actuals }], total, hasMore, nextCursor }. Params: includeArchived (default false), limit (1-10, def 10), cursor?, fields?, includeRaw.

includeArchived.description: Include archived projects in the totals. Default false.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 10, default 10.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Runn aggregate objects. Default false.
